quality.rationale: Open P2 backlog is implemented and verified with automated tests, production build, and headless Chromium runtime gate. Coverage includes current edit state save, autosave toggle, reload restore, multi-select angle matching, CSV/HTML import, inspector layer editing, WebP export, and mobile no-overflow. Cross-browser, real-device, and browser storage quota edge cases remain future work.

cost.rationale: Static browser-only GitHub Pages app with no backend, no paid service dependency, and browser-local edit state, template, color, and custom font storage.

delivery.rationale: TODO and local Issues are closed, implementation and docs are aligned, user guide is present, tests/build/runtime gate pass, and docs packaging remains available through the existing workflow. A fresh remote Pages run after this commit remains pending until pushed.

satisfaction.rationale: Requested improvements passed: current edit state save, autosave toggle, reload restore, multi-select angle matching, feature/usage documentation, improvement taskization, CSV/HTML import, inspector editing, WebP export, and QCDS evidence update. Remaining satisfaction risk is storage quota behavior, broader real-user font files, template variety, and non-Chromium browser coverage.
